$comment: The build date on the About page, in the one form both clients use. Every runtime has its own way of turning a moment into a readable date and no two agree, so the same build would otherwise show two different dates on the same person's two devices. The day is taken straight off the ISO string: a build date is not a timestamp anybody needs to the second, and no timezone arithmetic means no chance of the two landing on different days. Shared by tests/shared/about.test.ts and the Android SharedCorpusTest.

dates.name: a space instead of the T
no leading zero on the day
a month that does not exist
a year too short to be one
